rationale: The assistant asked the right timing question, then had the customer unplug and check drum play and grinding by hand, correctly reaching worn drum bearings and noting the sealed bearing unit. It refused to guide dismantling and referred to an engineer with sensible repair-vs-replace advice. Weaknesses: it never asked age or ruled out a trapped object, stated 'the internal bearing and spider assembly are worn out or broken' with more certainty than the evidence supports for the spider, and recommended replacement without suggesting an engineer quote first, though the advice is sound for a 9-year-old £350 machine.
